frontmatter.title: The Status Flip
frontmatter.statement: Can generosity become a stronger status signal than consumption, and what would that unlock?
frontmatter.progress: Field evidence that a status mechanism tied to what gifts achieve changes giving behavior at scale.
frontmatter.bounty: Unfunded. The Question Bounties program will attach prizes once it is funded.

subject.body:
## Why it matters

Humanity’s Checklist proposes directing status toward generosity. Whether that would increase giving or improve its results is a hypothesis to test. See [the Prestige Economy](/diagnosis/prestige-economy/).

## Where to start

Humanity’s Checklist proposes charity designer goods, where the coolest thing you can wear shows how much you gave. Testing that proposal, and others like Charitology’s shareable [Wrapped](/tools/charitology-wrapped/) card, is a concrete first experiment.
